body:
**From DM-3 review (orchestrator):** two color sources sit outside the `:root` tokens, so changing token values alone will miss them:

- `src/renderer/src/graph/flowElements.ts` hardcodes the edge arrowhead colors as `MET_COLOR = "#8a8070"` and `WAITING_COLOR = "#6a6254"` (`markerEnd.color`). They equal `--edge` and `--edge-waiting`, but in TS, so the arrowheads keep the old colors after a palette swap.
- `src/renderer/src/styles.css` has four `rgba(236, 230, 218, 0.04)` hover washes (the old `--ink` at 4%) that are not tokens.

Route both through tokens when applying the palette (or in DM-8 for the graph).
